verdict.rationale: Rootly's retrospective docs say AI drafts Summary, Impact, Root Cause, Mitigation, Resolution and Curated Timeline sections from incident data, Slack and bridge transcripts. AI blocks draft sections such as Contributing Factors. Drafts land in a collaborative rich-text editor where humans review them. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that AI drafts follow-up/action-item sections (action items appear only as an input to AI Summaries), and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
